$comment: compare-territories-1 (25 Nov 2026): competitors read on their OWN websites by three Claude Code agents, one request at a time each (docs/checker-prep-1-report.md; built by docs/compare-territories-1/build.cjs). Imported automatically, once per version of this file, by the first step of the nightly competitor check (lib/data-import/). Every row source research, UNVERIFIED (35.an-1). Each answer carries the vendor’s verbatim quote and its page (35.an-4); "no" only with a quote saying it is not offered, silence is not_mentioned (35.ao-7). monthly_minor is MINOR units, converted from the page’s amount with lib/money-format.ts toMinorUnits (the 100× guard). request_check sets check_requested_at. "evidence" and "not_relevant" are for the reviewer; the import does not read them (the importer cannot mark a competitor not relevant).
